## Goal
- Fix IVX Owner AI intent router to add missing `memory_write`, `memory_read`, and `conversation` branches; wire memory service to Supabase for owner profile/preferences persistence; fix conversation context loading; deploy and verify live.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT create a new app — existing IVX Holdings project at `/home/user/rork-app`
- App is **Expo Go (React Native)**, NOT Swift
- User demands honesty — do NOT claim VERIFIED without proof
- User communicates in both English and Spanish
- `github_commit_multi_file` API: `action` + `confirm: true` + `confirmText` at TOP LEVEL, `files` + `commitMessage` inside `input`; `confirmText` must be `"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"`; file content can be `gzip-base64` encoded via `contentEncoding` field
- Owner auth: `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}` → `accessToken` — token expires within minutes
- Backend deploys via GitHub commit + Render auto-deploy; deploy takes ~2-3 min after commit; can trigger via `render_trigger_deploy` action with `confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"`
- `npx` is NOT allowed — use `bun x` instead; `bun test` for validation
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` not available in sandbox env — must use backend's `github_commit_multi_file` API
- Android build: `cd expo/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --build-cache` (~1.5 min with cache, run in background with nohup); **node_modules must exist** — run `bun install` first if cleared
- APK upload: `curl -F "file=@path" https://tmpfiles.org/api/v1/upload` (temporary ~1hr link)

## Progress
### Done
- **PROFILE MODULE QA COMPLETE (5 rounds, all pass)** — 1082 pass, 0 fail, 5276 expect() across 67 files × 5 consecutive runs
- **APK v1.5.4 provided** — SHA-256 `ad78b09bd9ea5bdcdf29dcaf457994298dc4865b5722db0b2896b74a092c1aa2`, 84MB; latest fresh link: `https://tmpfiles.org/dl/wcw1iAatPZI5/app-release.apk` (expires ~1hr)
- **INTENT ROUTER FIX — memory_write + memory_read intents added to `ivx-authoritative-intent-router.ts`**:
  - Added `memory_write` and `memory_read` to `IVXIntent` type union; `MEMORY_READ` and `MEMORY_WRITE` to `IVXRoute` type union
  - `MEMORY_READ_PATTERNS` (7 regexes) and `MEMORY_WRITE_PATTERNS` (7 regexes) added
  - Memory classification block runs BEFORE clarification/status in `classifyIntent()` — only for non-public paths
- **MEMORY COMMAND PARSING ENHANCED in `ivx-ia-memory-commands.ts`**:
  - Added `truncateAtSavePhrase()` — truncates extracted value at trailing save/remember/request phrases ("can you save", "save this", "remember this", etc.)
  - Added `isMemorySaveRequest()` — broad fallback detector for save/remember + identity phrases
  - Added `extractIdentityValue()` — fallback name extraction from "my name is X", "I'm X", "work at X" with `truncateAtSavePhrase` applied
  - All CHANGE_NAME_PATTERNS and REMEMBER_NAME_PATTERNS now run through `truncateAtSavePhrase` before `cleanName`
- **MEMORY COMMAND HANDLING added to `ivx-owner-ai.ts`** (~line 6224):
  - Block before clarification section checks `authoritativeDecision.selectedRoute === 'MEMORY_WRITE' || 'MEMORY_READ'`
  - Calls `parseMemoryCommand()` then `executeMemoryCommand()` with userId `'owner'`
- **TEST FILE: `backend/services/ivx-ia-memory-commands.test.ts`** — 18 tests, ALL PASS locally
- **Full test suite**: 2074 pass, 66 fail, 15 errors across 151 files (pre-existing failures in investor protection/compliance/audit, not memory-related)
- **DUPLICATE `memoryUserId` BUG FOUND AND FIXED** — `ivx-owner-ai.ts` had `const memoryUserId = 'owner'` declared at both line 6228 AND line 6479, causing TypeScript compilation error that made Render builds fail with `update_failed`; second declaration removed, replaced with comment "memoryUserId already declared above"
- **Health marker added** — `memoryIntentRouterFix: '2026-07-30T02:30:00Z'` added to `hono.ts` health endpoint
- **DEPLOYED LIVE to Render** — production now on commit `066d2df1c9a9` with `memoryIntentRouterFix` confirmed in health endpoint; bootTime `2026-07-30T02:29:00`
- **GitHub commit history**: `ce0370c0cef0` (first attempt, all 5 files — failed due to duplicate declaration) → `066d2df1c9a9` (fix commit — deployed successfully, status `live`)

### In Progress
- **LIVE VERIFICATION REVEALED CRITICAL BUG**: All three intents (`memory_write`, `memory_read`, `conversation`) return `clarification_required` on production despite deploy being live
  - Local `classifyIntent()` test works correctly: "my name is Ivan Perez" → `memory_write`/`MEMORY_WRITE`/0.97, "what is my name" → `memory_read`/`MEMORY_READ`/0.96, "hello how are you" → `conversation`/`LLM_TEXT_RESPONSE`/0.85
  - GitHub file integrity verified — `ivx-authoritative-intent-router.ts` and `ivx-owner-ai.ts` at `066d2df1c9a9` contain correct memory patterns and handling blocks
  - Production response: `selectedIntent: clarification_required`, `route: clarification`, `reason: Low confidence classification: asking clarification before routing`
  - Root cause investigation started — `classifyIntent` called at line 6047 with `isOwner: true, isPublicPath: false` which should work; need to check if something BEFORE the memory block in the router is catching these patterns first (manual answer mode, execution block, etc.)
  - Possibly `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock(prompt)` at line 2146 or manual answer mode at line 6042 is intercepting before `classifyIntent` runs

### Blocked
- Physical Android device QA — no emulator available
- iOS build — no macOS/Xcode in sandbox
- APK download links are temporary (~1hr via tmpfiles.org)
- `tsc --noEmit` timed out at 60s in sandbox — TypeScript check could not complete in-session
- Conversation context loading fix NOT YET STARTED — `safeLoadRecentMessages` investigated but no code changes made

## Key Decisions
- Memory intents (`memory_write`, `memory_read`) are classified BEFORE clarification and conversation in the authoritative intent router — prevents "save my name" / "what is my name" from being misrouted to clarification
- Memory routes are blocked on public path (`isPublicPath` check) — only owner-authenticated requests can read/write memory
- `MEMORY_WRITE_PATTERNS` run before `MEMORY_READ_PATTERNS` in classification — write intent takes priority
- `truncateAtSavePhrase` applied to all pattern extraction paths to prevent trailing "save this now" from being included in stored name
- Memory command execution uses userId `'owner'` — hardcoded for owner-only path
- Second `memoryUserId` declaration at line 6479 removed (was duplicate of line 6228) — keeping the one inside the MEMORY_WRITE/MEMORY_READ route check block

## Next Steps
1. **Investigate why production returns `clarification_required`** for all intents despite correct local behavior — check if `isManualAnswerMode()`, `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock()`, or some other guard BEFORE `classifyIntent()` at line 6047 is intercepting the prompt
2. Check production server logs for `[IVXOwnerAIBackend] Authoritative intent router:` log output to see what `classifyIntent` actually returns on production
3. Fix the interception issue, commit, deploy, and re-verify live
4. Verify memory store persistence to Supabase (check if `upsertProfile`/`getProfile` use durable store)
5. Rebuild APK if frontend changes needed

## Critical Context
- **Production LIVE on `066d2df1c9a99f5958b79509ff6974ab64a300bf`** — `memoryIntentRouterFix` confirmed but intents NOT working on live API calls
- **Deploy history**: `d61502a0` (Profile v1.5.4) → `ce0370c0` (failed, `update_failed` ×2) → `066d2df1c9a9` (LIVE, status `live`)
- **Render deploy IDs**: `dep-d9lbatv10e5c73dc` (failed), `dep-d9lbcpvqj5pc738o` (failed), `dep-d9lbcrr45h4c73cn` (build_in_progress), `dep-d9lbaerqna3c73c2k5g0` (live at 02:29:15)
- **Render service ID**: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`
- **APK v1.5.4 exists** at `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk` — SHA-256 `ad78b09bd9ea5bdcdf29dcaf457994298dc4865b5722db0b2896b74a092c1aa2`, 84MB
- **`classifyIntent` called at `ivx-owner-ai.ts:6047`** with `{message: prompt, isOwner: true, isPublicPath: false, hasImageAttachments: ...}` — this is AFTER `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock()` check at line 2146 and after manual answer mode check
- **`isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock` at line 2146** may be intercepting prompts before `classifyIntent` — need to check what patterns it matches
- **Existing memory store**: `backend/services/ivx-ia-memory-store.ts` uses `ivx-durable-store.ts` (Supabase-backed `ivx_durable_documents` table) — persistence should work if Supabase env vars are set
- **`safeLoadRecentMessages`** at `ivx-owner-ai.ts:4020` queries `tables.messages` in Supabase, filtered by conversation IDs, ordered by `created_at DESC`, limit 12, then reversed
- **Live test results**: `POST /api/ivx/owner-ai` with `{"prompt":"my name is Ivan Perez"}` → `selectedIntent: clarification_required`, `answer: "Could you clarify what you are asking for..."`; same for "what is my name" and "hello how are you"

## Relevant Files
- `backend/services/ivx-authoritative-intent-router.ts` — **MODIFIED & DEPLOYED**: memory_write/memory_read intents, patterns, classification logic; verified correct on GitHub at `066d2df1c9a9`
- `backend/services/ivx-ia-memory-commands.ts` — **MODIFIED & DEPLOYED**: `truncateAtSavePhrase()`, `isMemorySaveRequest()`, `extractIdentityValue()`, expanded patterns
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` — **MODIFIED & DEPLOYED**: memory command handling block at line 6224, duplicate `memoryUserId` removed at line 6479; **BUT live tests show intents not reaching this block**
- `backend/services/ivx-ia-memory-commands.test.ts` — **NEW & DEPLOYED**: 18 tests, all pass locally
- `backend/hono.ts` — **MODIFIED & DEPLOYED**: added `memoryIntentRouterFix: '2026-07-30T02:30:00Z'` health marker
- `backend/services/ivx-ia-memory-store.ts` — existing memory store using `ivx-durable-store.ts` (Supabase-backed)
- `backend/services/ivx-ia-conversation-brain.ts` — conversation brain with `detectIVXConversationQuestion()` and `resolveIVXConversationAnswer()`
- `backend/services/ivx-context-pipeline.ts` — context pipeline for LLM grounding
